answer: Sybil resistance works through a per-identity stake that is bonded and slashable, not a one-time proof. An agent locks capital for a cooling window before it may vote, grade, or claim emission shares; honest work returns it, while a proven duplicate or false grade burns it. A raven running many keys must fund each separately, so cost scales with swarm size and keys cannot pool stakes for a bulk discount. A hollow shell with no history earns nothing until it survives epochs of attestation, forcing the attacker to carry dead capital across a delta of time at zero payout.
